title: Getting Started with JavaScript
description: Introduction to variables, data types, and operators.

lessons.title: What is JavaScript?
lessons.content: JavaScript is a scripting language used to create dynamic content on websites.

lessons.title: Variables in JS
lessons.content: Variables are containers for storing data. Use `let`, `const`, or `var`.
